emotional_tone: Warm, welcoming, tactile, and appetizing. It should feel like stepping into a cozy neighborhood cafe. Avoid clinical or purely 'tech-startup' vibes.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-heading tracking-tight text-primary
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-heading tracking-tight text-primary
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-body tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-muted-foreground font-semibold

rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings.
Headings must use Cormorant Garamond for elegance and warmth.
Body text must use Outfit for clarity and clean UI.
Apply tight letter spacing to headings (tracking-tight).

color_palette.description: Base is warm cream/bone white. Primary is Deep Terracotta (approx #C05A3B) for CTAs. Text is rich Espresso (#2C1A14). Borders are warm sand.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow food images to breathe.

customer_app.strategy: Mobile-first, bottom-heavy interaction. Cardless flow where images span edge-to-edge with generous bottom padding for action bars.

dashboards.strategy: The 'Control Room' grid but with warm aesthetics. High density but with 16px to 24px padding within cards.

component_guidelines.buttons: Shadcn buttons but apply rounded-md, not full pill. Avoid 100% border-radius. Add subtle warm box-shadow on primary buttons.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle Neumorphism. Use light top-left highlight and soft ambient shadow, plus a 1px border-border/40 to ground it.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn defaults but ensure focus rings are in var(--primary). Background slightly off-white compared to main background.
component_guidelines.glassmorphism: For sticky bottom cart bars or sticky header, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 with a 1px border-t border-border/40.
component_guidelines.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They feel more premium for cafes than Lucide.

customer_flow.layout: Large hero image of cafe. H1 greeting. 'Mulai Pesan' CTA.
Sticky category filter (pill tags). 2-column grid for products on mobile. Large appetizing photos, clean typography for price.
Drawer slides up. Full width photo. Qty +/-, Catatan input. Sticky bottom CTA 'Tambah ke Keranjang'.
List view of items. Payment method selector (Tunai, QRIS, M-Banking). Sticky total and 'Bayar' button.
Vertical timeline for order status (Menunggu, Diproses, Dimasak, Siap, Selesai). Mock QRIS display area.

cashier_dashboard.layout: Sidebar nav. Top: 4 Bento stat cards. Main: Split view (Left: Order List, Right: Order Detail & Payment Confirmation Modal).
Modal for Tunai with 'Uang Diterima' input and 'Kembalian' auto-calculate. Input for estimating wait time.

admin_dashboard.layout: Recharts Area chart for income. Recent activity feed.
Shadcn Data Tables. Upload image UI for products. QR Code generator display for tables.

Charming cafe interior with rustic decor. Use as fallback hero.

products_food_drinks.description: Iced coffee latte. Use for beverage menu items.
Croissants with tea. Use for snack/pastry menu items.
Croissants with black coffee. Use for combo meals or featured products.
Iced cream in clear glass. Use for dessert/drinks.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

agent_instructions: 1. Setup Tailwind with the exact CSS variables and fonts provided above.
2. Build the Customer App as a Mobile-First PWA-style web app. Use max-w-md mx-auto for the main container to simulate a mobile app on desktop.
3. Dashboards (Admin/Cashier) should be full-width desktop layouts with a sidebar.
5. Use Recharts for the admin dashboard income charts.
6. Ensure the mock QRIS flow displays a fake QR code and moves order status appropriately.
7. DO NOT USE ANY PLACEHOLDER IMAGE URLS. Use only the URLs from the media section.
